name: 音视频同步分析
description: 检测视频中音频与视觉元素之间的不匹配，以识别AI生成或篡改的内容。
useCase: 通过音视频同步分析识别AI生成的视频
mechanism: Analyzes the temporal synchronization between audio signals and visual content, including speech-lip correlation, environmental sound-scene consistency, and audio-visual event timing. AI生成的 videos often have subtle desynchronization between audio and visual channels.
source: Chugh et al. (2020) - Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection, ACM Multimedia
algorithm: 跨模态时间对齐 + 音频频谱图分析 + 视觉事件检测
parameters: 音频采样率: 16kHz, 视频帧率: 原始, 对齐窗口: 100ms, 特征: MFCC + 视觉运动能量
strengths:
• 利用跨模态信息实现鲁棒检测
• 对视觉上逼真的伪造有效
• 能检测音频拼接和配音
• 适用于多种视频类型
limitations:
• 需要具有有意义音频内容的视频
• 对音乐视频或环境声效果较差
• 需要足够的视频时长才能可靠分析
• 音频后处理可能掩盖伪影

references.title: Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM Multimedia.
Mittal, T. et al. (2020). Emotions Don't Lie: An Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection Method Using Affective Cues. ACM MM.
Lewis, J. et al. (2020). Deepfake Video Detection Based on Spatial, Spectral, and Temporal Inconsistencies. arXiv.
